#RUBSAll the World's Desire#RUBEAngra Mainyu#REND/CCC:#REND

The Noble Phantasm of the demonized Kiara Sessyoin.

By absorbing two Alter Egos and utilizing the Moon Cell,
Kiara Sessyoin turned into a demon.
She turns into an Earth Mother, accepting all of humanity's
desires and at the same time becoming a sacrifice to them.

An existence similar to the man-made demon who was
accused as a demon and honored as a sacrifice
to prove the evil of mankind.

Becoming the outlet for all of mankind's desires, she uses
her Code#RUBSTen Thousand Colored Stagnation#RUBE Cast Banshoku Yuutai#REND to invite people's souls,
billions of them, creating a maelstrom of pleasure.
That maelstrom melts those possessing intelligence,
sublimating their "lives" into a single moment.
It is the birth of a fleeting, but eternal#RUBSPure Land of Bliss#RUBE Sukhāvatī#REND.

This maelstrom of pleasure is effective on any being
with intelligence, regardless of its structure.
It is not a Noble Phantasm restricted to this World.
